name: MMDemo MetaModule Event Audit Contract
purpose: record explicit Event-definition evidence and unresolved Event coverage without inventing missing Events

statusModel.EVENTS_PROVEN: explicit canonical Event declarations are present and reviewed
statusModel.EVENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Event ownership applies but explicit canonical Event coverage is missing or incomplete
statusModel.EVENT_CONFLICT: canonical sources conflict on Event semantics/ownership
statusModel.NOT_EVENT_OWNER: current classification does not own Events

unresolvedActualMembers.rule: do not invent current 1.5 identities or Events

provenanceRules: locked semantic identity does not imply Events are proven
explicit empty behavior.events keeps status EVENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED
missing behavior.events keeps status EVENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED for actual Event-owning MetaModules
newer 1.5 grouping classification supersedes older unlocked Strategy/Everyday composition contracts for Event ownership
historical source disagreement is preserved as provenance rather than silently merged
missing Events are reviewed separately and never synthesized merely to satisfy final coverage
